channel.title: Violations Watch: Mexico
channel.description: New incidents reported in Mexico. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Mexico: journalist Eduardo Flores Salado, who reported on missing persons, found killed in Acapulco, Guerrero; perpetrators unknown; UNESCO, CPJ and RSF condemn the killing
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Acapulco, Guerrero, Mexico. Types: Attacks on journalists, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Unknown. Reported casualties: 1 killed. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1428

item.title: Journalist Eduardo Flores Salado of Enfoque Informativo Guerrero is found dead in Acapulco; a colleague says he was strangled, and state prosecutors have opened a murder inquiry (CPJ, RSF)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Acapulco, Guerrero, Mexico. Types: Attacks on journalists, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Unknown. Reported casualties: 1 killed. Disputed or caveats: Strangulation not confirmed by the authorities; no link to his work established yet. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1294

item.title: Seven-year-old American girl killed in Mexico; authorities investigate whether gunfire from a police helicopter was responsible
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Tamaulipas, Mexico. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Mexican police (under investigation). Reported casualties: 1 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Police helicopter gunfire alleged by family; investigation ongoing. 5 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0088
